cryptohome: Prepare to add UMA stats for mount result We would like to have UMA stats on how often mount fails, and how often this happens despite a correct password entered by user. In this CL we update the error codes for mount so that the caller has specific information on where the process failed. The UMA logging will be implemented on Chrome side. huddly-hpk-updater: improve output in udev_mode When running huddly-hpk-updater with the --udev_mode switch, it would output "Update finished successfully" after the first pass. This is misleading, since a verification pass is needed for the update to be persistent. This commit limits the "Update finished successfully" to the verification pass. BUG=b:133300259, chromium:979607 TEST=Manual: Ran update in udev_mode and observed output.
